item.title: BJC Healthcare reveals employee pay changes
item.description: BJC Healthcare announced a new compensation structure that it says would maintain or increase pay for 72% of its employees, but the health system did not immediately clarify impacts on the remaining 28% of its workforce.

item.title: Missouri bills would require drunk drivers who kill parents to pay child support
item.description: Two bills gaining momentum from Missouri lawmakers would require drivers convicted of killing a parent while intoxicated to pay child support to the surviving spouse or guardian raising the victim's child or children.

item.title: Two St. Charles County Catholic schools to reconfigure
item.description: ST. CHARLES COUNTY, Mo. - Beginning next school year, two Catholic schools in the St. Charles County area will be reconfiguring. According to the Archdiocese of St. Louis, St. Paul Parish in St. Paul and St. Joseph Parish in Josephville will be rearranging student levels at each campus. item.title: Convicted sex offender facing illegal gun charges in Warren County
item.description: A convicted sex offender from the Warrenton area is due in court next month after more than a dozen guns were found at his home.

item.title: St. Louis man sentenced for $300K Kohl’s Cash scheme
item.description: A St. Louis man was sentenced Thursday for a scheme taking place in multiple states that stole nearly $300,000 worth of merchandise from Kohl's.

item.title: Family discovers body after house fire in Wellston
item.description: A family is in mourning after learning that one of their loved ones was found deceased in a home that caught fire in Wellston.

item.title: CWE resident dealing with raw sewage backup, says city isn’t helping
item.description: A St. Louis woman says raw sewage keeps flooding her basement due to a broken pipe. It’s an issue that’s been plaguing her property for months.

item.title: UMSL faces complaint for alleged scholarship discrimination
item.description: A new federal civil rights complaint was filed against the University of Missouri - St. Louis for discrimination, one group says.

item.title: Wrong-way truck driver failed language proficiency test: MSHP
item.description: A Somali truck driver failed an English proficiency test after getting pulled over for driving the wrong way on Highway 61 in Lincoln County. The Missouri State Highway Patrol said he could not identify road signs required to hold a commercial driver’s license.

item.title: Court fight could send freed man back to prison
item.description: A court fight in a case that freed a Missouri man could now change how innocence claims are handled in court.
